Many gates are kept together in one yard document, each with its own revision. Commands change the yard in memory; the yard is written only by an explicit save, which carries one save id and expects the yard version last read. A save id that already landed is reported as saved with the version it produced, even after a restart, and is never written again. A save whose outcome is not known is reported as unknown; no further change is made until the stored yard has been inspected. A command for a gate the yard does not hold reports NoSuchGate. A command against a gate revision other than the one the caller acted on reports StaleEntry. A save against a yard that another writer has moved is refused and reports YardMoved.
